shared_or_similar_visual_information: A straight boundary separating the shaded and unshaded parts of a coordinate plane. Compare the diagonal line between the gray and white regions in the left image with the diagonal line between the gray and white regions in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dashed edge specifies a strict inequality, so equality points along the line are excluded. Right image: The dashed edge excludes the equality boundary of the shaded half-plane.
Rationales: Both shaded regions use a dashed boundary for a strict inequality. The marked points locate each boundary line, and equality remains excluded.
